title: Fragments of a Broken Narrative
text:
Postmodern fiction often refuses the reassuring coherence of the traditional novel. Its authors frequently dismantle chronology, foreground the artifice of narration, and invite readers to question whether any story can represent reality faithfully. Experimental writers such as those of the nouveau roman, for instance, replaced psychological depth with meticulous descriptions of objects. The result is a text that demands active participation rather than passive consumption.

Critics remain divided about whether this fragmentation is a radical political gesture or merely an elegant exhaustion of literary conventions. Some argue that by exposing the machinery of storytelling, these works liberate readers from ideological manipulation. Others contend that their deliberate obscurity alienates precisely the audiences they hope to empower. Whatever the verdict, the experimental novel has forced literature to reconsider its own foundations.

options: Restore the coherence of traditional novels

questions.text: According to the second paragraph, what do some critics argue these works do?
options: Increase the sales of traditional novels

questions.text: What can be inferred about the reader of experimental fiction, based on the first paragraph?
options: The reader is expected to take an active part in building meaning
The reader is expected to accept the narrator's account without question
The reader is expected to look only for psychological insight
The reader is expected to prefer chronological plots

questions.text: The closing sentence of the passage suggests that experimental fiction has
options: forced literature to re-examine its basic assumptions
proven that all stories are historically accurate

paragraph_translations: La ficción posmoderna a menudo rechaza la coherencia tranquilizadora de la novela tradicional. Sus autores suelen desmantelar la cronología, subrayar el artificio de la narración e invitan al lector a cuestionar si alguna historia puede representar la realidad con fidelidad. Los escritores experimentales, como los del nouveau roman, por ejemplo, sustituyeron la profundidad psicológica por descripciones meticulosas de objetos. El resultado es un texto que exige una participación activa y no un consumo pasivo.

Los críticos siguen divididos sobre si esta fragmentación es un gesto político radical o simplemente un agotamiento elegante de las convenciones literarias. Algunos sostienen que, al exponer la maquinaria de la narración, estas obras liberan al lector de la manipulación ideológica. Otros afirman que su oscuridad deliberada aliena precisamente a los públicos que pretenden empoderar. Sea cual sea el veredicto, la novela experimental ha obligado a la literatura a reconsiderar sus propios fundamentos.
